query: /wrike-task <link to a task in an active status with no code reference>
expected_behavior: Loads Wrike tools with one ToolSearch and fetches details, comments and children in the same turn
Classifies as To do and writes a brief of at most 15 lines before reading any code
Reads only files the task names, and makes the first edit within about 20 turns

query: /wrike-task <link to a task whose merge request is open with no unresolved threads and status in review>
expected_behavior: Classifies as Waiting review with the deciding sign stated
Reports and offers a review or a nudge without posting anything unasked

query: /wrike-task <link to a task whose merge request has unresolved reviewer threads>
expected_behavior: Checks out the request branch and addresses only the feedback
Asks before commenting on the task or the request, or changing status

query: /wrike-task <link to a task in a completed status whose merge request is merged>
expected_behavior: Classifies as Done, takes no action, and reports it in one short brief
